specs.Item Type Name: Portable Retro Bluetooth Speaker –Wired USB Laptop Home Speaker with FM Radio Stereo Speaker & Soundbar for Home

features: Vintage Elegance Meets Modern Tech: Blending a classic wooden finish with advanced audio technology, this sound bar adds a touch of timeless sophistication to any space while delivering high-quality sound.
Superior Sound Quality: Enjoy an immersive audio experience with this Bluetooth speaker featuring 25W of clear, crisp sound for gaming, movies, and music.

Multichannel Connectivity: No complicated setups; this USB speaker sound bar connects effortlessly to PCs, laptops, and TVs, allowing you to enjoy your music or enhance your viewing experience instantly. Works smoothly with a wide range of devices, including Windows and Mac computers, Android and iOS devices.
Intuitive Control Knob: Adjust volume and power on/off with a simple turn of the knob – a user-friendly feature that brings convenience to your fingertips.

Good Battery Life- The 5000mAh powerful battery plays music up to 8 hours on a single charge. No batteries required, reducing waste and ensuring you can enjoy your music as long as your device is on with cable charging.
description: Experience premium sound with this 25W Bluetooth portable speaker, designed to elevate your audio experience whether at home or on the go. This wireless USB speaker offers superior stereo sound quality, perfect for laptops, smartphones, and other devices. Its sleek, compact design makes it an ideal home speaker, delivering deep bass and clear treble, while the Bluetooth functionality ensures seamless connectivity. Whether you’re hosting a party or enjoying music alone, this versatile speaker provides powerful performance in any setting. The 25W output ensures your tunes are always loud and clear, creating the perfect atmosphere for any occasion.
